text:
Julia: Quick sync — stitching up Optimize toolkit delivery. Need clear ownership: quant recs, batching/caching, and regression alerts. Milestone for this sprint (end of week) — are we on track? @Omar @Samir

Omar: I can own quant recs. PR #4321 has the initial profiles, waiting on perf runs from the nightly job. Noted a 5-8% CPU regression on 8k contexts with act-order disabled.

Samir: I’ll take batching + caching. Working in branch feature/batch-cache, PR #4330. Plan: add prefix KV caching + adaptive batch window. Need infra toggle to increase shared mem for canaries (memlock). @infra-bot can you check capacity in us-west-2?

infra-bot: infra-bot: Can enable memlock on canaries in us-west-2 by EOD. Created ticket INF-210 and scheduled a short maintenance window 2300-2330 UTC.

Priya: I'll own regression alerts / eval hooks. Adding light-weight eval job in CI that runs on every canary roll (subset of 50 prompts). Thresholds: perplexity delta <= 0.03 and top-k recall >= 0.96 — can iterate. Need the canonical eval list from research. Link: https://go/internal/optkit-evals (will post a trimmed copy).

Alice: Quick CR notes: left comments on #4321 and #4330 — two main blockers: missing quant kernel fallback for MQA and a race in batch coalescer on cold-start. If Samir wants, I can pair on the coalescer fix.

Omar: For the quant kernel, adding a fallback path is cheap but will need runtime tests. Example config I'm testing locally: 
```
quant_mode: q4_0
act_order: true
kv_cache: true
```
If act_order=false, latency drops on short sequences but we saw regressions on long contexts — need wider perf matrix.

Julia: Milestones: 1) Enable memlock on canary (infra) — today; 2) green perf runs for PR #4321 — tomorrow morning; 3) batch/cache PR review + coalescer fix merged — two days; 4) canary rollout with eval hooks — by sprint end (6 days). If any of these slip, we triage at the delivery call tomorrow 11:00. Assigning owners: quant -> Omar, batch/cache -> Samir, regressions -> Priya, runtime pairing -> Lena (for kernel pairing).

Lena: Ack — will pair with Omar and Samir tomorrow 10:00 PT to unblock kernel + coalescer.

Alice: Pinged on CR threads and added an example test for the race condition.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for optkit v0.13 on us-west-2 cluster (canary-7). Smoke endpoint: curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood-inference.internal/optkit/v0/generate -d '{"input":"test"}'

Samir: Running local smoke tests now. Will post results to the PR. If infra memlock isn't enabled by EOD, I'll fallback to a reduced cache size and note the perf delta.

Julia: Thanks — please update the PRs with short checklist (perf, tests, CR) so we can track. Putting a soft blocker on any new features until canary is stable. :thumbsup:
